title: CPCSC Level 1 media sanitization needs controlled disposition receipts
remediation: The sponsor information custodian and media disposal owner identify assessed media and approved sanitization methods for reuse, disposal and transfer outside organizational control. Sample a controlled case showing custody, authorization, the sanitization result and verification before release. Store evidence under controlled identifiers without exposing contract information. The sponsor separately confirms applicability to the CPCSC Level 1 contract and certification boundary. An ITSP.10.171 reference or evidence mapped for a different assessed system establishes no disposition for this contract.

milestones.title: For CPCSC Level 1, collect approved sanitization methods and a traceable media record showing custody, verification and disposition authorization
